shared_elements: standing human figures shown frontally/in profile
rows of repeated small vertical strokes (crew marks / figures in file)
horizontally banded, register-like organisation of repeated motifs
wheeled/curved vehicle-like forms (chariot in A, boat hulls in B)
justification: Both surfaces organise repeated units into roughly horizontal rows, and both include human figures rendered as repeated vertical strokes in file — the crew-lines of B superficially echo the ranked file of attendants in A. But A is a naturalistic, deeply modelled procession of costumed figures with a chariot and detailed dress, weapons and hands, while B is a sparse, wholly schematic scatter of stick-figures and crescent-hulled boats with no shared specific motif or relationship.
